name: - to the lady in the moon
source:
An unfathomable amount of years ago,  a mortal woman stole two elixirs of immortality and is named the goddess of the moon. 

An unending amount of years later, she still lives.

[From [url=https://yosharoos.itch.io/to-the-lady-in-the-moon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
不知多少年前，一个凡间女子偷了两颗长生不老药，被封为嫦娥。

无数年过去了，她仍然活着。

[来自[url=https://yosharoos.itch.io/to-the-lady-in-the-moon]itch.io[/url]]
